exactIdConfirmation.rule: Hardcoded targetId = "test_mission_catalog_bridge"; no wildcard or pattern matching.

dryRunDefault.rule: Defaults to DRY-RUN mode. Live delete executes ONLY when explicit --apply argument is present.

dependencyPreflight.rule: Audits presence across all 3 collections before attempting doc delete.

zeroWildcardDeletion.rule: Strictly document-level targeted delete; zero collection/subcollection drops.

idempotentSecondRun.rule: Subsequent runs evaluate exists=false and perform zero operations.
